title: Universal rank matching for one direct image relative to a reference bundle
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $E,F$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules. For $k:Y\to S$, let $p_k:X\times_S Y\to Y$ and $q_k:X\times_S Y\to X$ be the projections. Define $R_1(f,E,F,g)$ to mean that for every $h:T\prime\to T$ and $t\in T\prime$ there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $t$ and $r\in\mathbb N$ such that both $(p_{hg,*}q_{hg}^*F)|_U$ and $q_{U\to T\prime\to T\to S}^*E$ are finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Pullback is the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and direct image is ordinary module pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. This imposes one direct-image rank condition, with E fixing its rank.
